item.text: {"summary":"The current Status::SetPayload implementation appears to mutate an existing shared StatusRep directly, which can explain the copy-assignment and equality failures. The erase failures remain unexplained because the available excerpt omits the StatusRep cloning and full erase behavior.","hypotheses":["Status::SetPayload bypasses copy-on-write for non-inlined statuses, so changing a copied status can change its source and make distinct statuses compare equal.","StatusRep::CloneAndUnref or ErasePayload mishandles a shared rep or its payload storage, causing erasure from a copy to remove the source payload too."],"queries":["StatusRep::CloneAndUnref","StatusRep::ErasePayload","StatusRep::StatusRep","Status::Ref(uintptr_t rep)"],"reads":[{"path":"absl/status/internal/status_internal.cc","line":1,"symbol":"StatusRep::CloneAndUnref"},{"path":"absl/status/internal/status_internal.cc","line":90,"symbol":"StatusRep::ErasePayload"},{"path":"absl/status/internal/status_internal.h","line":1,"symbol":"class StatusRep"},{"path":"absl/status/status.cc","line":1,"symbol":"Status::Ref"}],"ready":false}
